lines.text: She was called the Lioness of Lisabi. And she made a king step down.
Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti is often called the first woman in Nigeria to drive a car.
In the 1940s, she led the Abeokuta Women's Union against unfair taxes on market women.
Their protests pushed the Alake of Egbaland to step down, for a time, in 1949.
She was also the mother of Afrobeat legend Fela Kuti.
